svg.title: Enes K. Ergin, PhD
svg.desc: Bioinformatician in Vancouver: correct, fast, lightweight tools for biological data. Behind the name, one ridge per year of weekly GitHub contributions from 2014 to November 2026, newest in front; 4,013 contributions in 2026 so far.
